name: Age of Miracles
author: Wololoader
description: Adds the Age of Miracles lobby game mode. Monks generate Faith every 10 seconds, spent at the Monastery on Miracles (Bountiful Harvest, Holy Warriors, Plague, Divine Favour). First player to reach the Faith target wins!

resources.name: Faith
resources.description: Generated every 10 seconds by Monks (+1) and Monks with Relics (+3). Spend at the Monastery or reach the target to win.

game_modes.name: Age of Miracles
game_modes.description: Monks generate Faith over time. Cast Miracles from the Monastery command panel (Page 2), or be the first to reach the Faith target for victory!
